_comment: Skill pairs whose descriptions overlap at or above the collision threshold but are legitimately distinct. Add an entry only after reading both skills; the reason should state the boundary so the negative triggers can encode it. Everything not listed here is treated as an unreviewed collision and fails the gate.

reviewed_distinct.reason: Different sinks for the same primitive. hunt-host-header owns a Host or X-Forwarded-Host value that reaches application logic (reset-link poisoning, routing SSRF, OAuth issuer) and is never cached. hunt-cache-poison owns the case where the poisoned response is stored by a CDN or reverse proxy and served to other users. Boundary is already encoded as a mutual negative trigger in both descriptions.

Different scope. hunt-mfa-bypass proves a single second-factor bypass primitive (step skip, OTP replay, missing rate limit, factor downgrade). hunt-ato owns the full account-takeover taxonomy and the chaining of that primitive with reset flaws, session fixation and OAuth link CSRF into takeover of a second account. Boundary is already encoded as a mutual negative trigger in both descriptions.
